name: pricing-rows
title: Pricing rows
description: Plans as stacked rows: name and pitch on the left, price in the middle, action on the right, for four tiers or more.
docs: Pass plans (id, name, pitch, limits, price, period, action and featured), a title and a note. A numeric price is written as money in currency and locale and counts to its new value; text such as Free or Custom is shown as written. Give price and period as objects keyed by monthly and yearly and a billing toggle appears; control it with interval and onIntervalChange, or let it run itself from defaultInterval, and put yearlySaving beside the yearly option. A plan that gives only one interval keeps it for both. Switching is announced once. The featured plan gets a badge (its text can be changed per plan) and a heavier outline. The layout follows its own width: four columns when it is wide, name and limits beside price and action in the middle, and name, pitch, limits, price and action stacked on a phone, with full-width buttons. The action is any element, normally a Button; give the featured plan the solid one, and give each action an accessible name that includes its plan, such as aria-label="Start 14-day trial, Team plan", so a list of buttons does not read the same words several times. The names are headings one level below the title.
